Recent Reforms

13. There has been improvement in regulation and supervision. On the regulatory

side, the NRB is enlarging the prompt corrective action framework to include liquidity

and nonperforming asset ratio triggers with the previous CAR trigger. Further

strengthening of minimum capital adequacy by adopting some elements of Basel III,

including 4.5 percent common equity Tier 1 is also under consideration. Stress test

guidelines were recently issued as well as guidelines on the Internal Capital Adequacy

Assessment Process. An internal reorganization in the NRB broke up a department in
